manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use both arms to grab the small yellow-marked hamburg wrapper and the golden fries in red holder and set them on the beige tray with soft edges.

Task description: Use both arms to place the hamburger with a yellow mark on the left and the red box of golden fries on the right onto the beige round-edged tray in the center.

Success criteria: Both objects are on the tray; viewed from above, the burger and fries box are each near their designated placement positions on the tray, and both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider having the left arm approach the burger on the left and the right arm approach the fries box on the right, leaving clearance between the arms above the tray to avoid crossed or colliding grippers.
- Grip the substantial, wrapped body of the hamburger on opposite sides, avoiding protruding folds in the packaging. The gripper opening need only be slightly wider than the grasp area, reducing the chance of brushing nearby objects.
- Consider gripping the sides of the fries box body below the opening where there is still a broad contact area, avoiding a grasp only on protruding fries or the thin edge of the opening.
- Confirm the fingers actually straddle the item with sufficient pad contact before closing. If occluded, adjust the viewing angle rather than inferring enclosure from image overlap alone.
- When crossing the tray rim, leave height clearance for both object bottoms and fingertips. Allow room to open at the placement point and release once the tray bottom reliably supports the object, avoiding rim collisions, tipping, or moving the other item.
